transcript.question: Is Cameron Coscia's aggressive, nine-move waiver approach with The Stinky Faggots smart roster-building or just churn masking a team that's actually thin?

hotSeat.why: Nina Sharpe is favorite on them (+72), Curtis Vaughn is neutral on them (+9)

sides.mel-diaper: The process is scattershot — nine waiver moves this week for guys like Will Reichard for zero dollars and a 49ers D/ST for zero dollars is not a plan, it's panic depth.
sides.reggie-banks: The scoreboard says 5-3, fourth in the standings, and Bijan Robinson has already dropped 35.8 in a single week for this roster, so whatever Cameron's doing is working.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Good evening. The Stinky Faggots dropped a nine-acquisition waiver binge on the league this week and still needed a last-gasp Chase Brown afternoon just to beat GLORY ASSHOLE by 6.1. So: is Cameron Coscia building a roster or just burning FAAB? Mel, you've got the board. Take it away.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: NINE PICKUPS. NINE! And what did The Stinky Faggots buy this week? A kicker for ZERO DOLLARS and the 49ers D/ST for ZERO DOLLARS, with $76 of $100 still sitting in the damn drawer. That's not roster-building, that's a guy grabbing lottery scratchers at the gas station. They won by 6.1 with 105.4 the week before. I say The Stinky Faggots finish outside the top three. Book it.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots finish outside the top three — no better than fourth — at the end of the regular season

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Mel, $76 in the drawer is not a crime, it's CHANGE. The Stinky Faggots are 5-3 and fourth with 1,094.2 points. Bijan Robinson went 35.8 in a week, Rico Dowdle 33.9, Cam Skattebo 31 — 185.4 that afternoon. Cute draft board. I say they finish top three, and Josh Allen's 24.2 last Sunday is why. Damn right.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots finish top three in the regular season standings

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: CHANGE?! Reggie, you just quoted a 185.4 from Week 6 — go look at Week 7. ONE HUNDRED FIVE POINT FOUR. Bijan 21.2, Skattebo 18.4, and they LOST to IR Squad by 11.3. Then 116.9 last Sunday. That's a half-assed two weeks in a row, and the fix was a free kicker. A FREE KICKER! Nina, grade it.

managerMentions.evidence: That's a half-assed two weeks in a row, and the fix was a free kicker.

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class, let's grade "top three" against the standing rows. The Stinky Faggots sit fourth at 5-3, 1094.2 points — one row below top three, on eight games. Partly supported: the record holds it up, the seed doesn't. Eight games, hold it loosely.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Nina says the record holds it up — I'll take that. Mel, you want the free kicker? Cam Skattebo was pick 146 and he's RB10 with 113.8 points. Rico Dowdle went 32.4 and 33.9 in back-to-back weeks. Khalil Shakir put up 20.8 last Sunday in a six-point win. That's not panic depth, that's a hell of a bench turning into starters. Scoreboard.
factsCited: board RB Cam Skattebo rank 10, 113.8, draftPick 146

managerMentions.evidence: That's not panic depth, that's a hell of a bench turning into starters.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: A BENCH TURNING INTO STARTERS?! Reggie, the bench was SEVENTEEN POINT EIGHT in Week 7 and NINETEEN POINT SEVEN last Sunday. There's nothing back there! And they had Kyle Monangai at ZERO DOLLARS and got outbid — OUTBID BY TWO BUCKS by a 2-6 Prolapsed Peehole. NINE pickups, $76 in the drawer, and you lose a running back over two damn dollars. That's not depth, that's a hell of a shopping list with no wallet. Dex, is that reported or am I making it up?

managerMentions.evidence: NINE pickups, $76 in the drawer, and you lose a running back over two damn dollars.

turns.speaker: dex-alvarez
turns.text: REPORTED. Vincent Coscia won Kyle Monangai for two dollars, outbidding The Stinky Faggots' zero-dollar bid. It's in the waiver log for the week, clean and confirmed. That's the wire on that one.
factsCited: W9 waiver claim: Vincent Coscia won Kyle Monangai for $2, outbid The Stinky Faggots $0

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Reported! Great. Now report the record. Two dollars for Kyle Monangai — a man with 2.4 points on the season, and Prolapsed Peehole is 2-6 with 907.1 points, last in the league. Mel, you're mad they didn't outbid the worst team in the building for a guy who's scored 2.4. Meanwhile A.J. Brown went 28.1 in Week 7 and Josh Allen 24.2 last Sunday. 5-3. I'll wait.

managerMentions.evidence: Prolapsed Peehole is 2-6 with 907.1 points, last in the league.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Let's settle the seeding question with history behind it. Walt, you're up — swing vote, historical parallel, first-person verdict. Go.

turns.speaker: walt-brennan
turns.text: This league's record only goes back to this season, so I won't pretend to have seen this movie before. What I've got is fourth place, 1,094.2 points, and a bench that hasn't scored in two weeks. That's not a burn, that's a team living paycheck to paycheck. I'd call the seeding fragile, not fake. Reggie's got the better of it, but Mel's right that the wallet's for show.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: Walt says the wallet's for show — THAT'S MY POINT. Reggie, look at Week 9. The Stinky Faggots are projected 129.7, the LOWEST projection on the whole slate, and they're at GLORY ASSHOLE at 140. Two kickers and two defenses rostered right now. TWO OF EACH! That's not depth, that's a garage full of spare tires and no engine. NINE pickups bought a 129.7.

turns.speaker: sam-ortega

verdict.reason: The Stinky Faggots are fourth at 1094.2 points, closer to Reggie's top-three call than Mel's outside-top-three call, but neither is fully supported.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Neither debater has a decision on the books yet this season, so we start clean tonight. Nina just called both claims unsupported — fourth is fourth. Mel, Reggie, last jabs, then I want a verdict.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: FOURTH. FOURTH, Reggie! Nina just read it and you're still selling me flowers. NINE pickups, TWENTY-FOUR DOLLARS, and $76 rotting in the drawer — a free kicker and a free 49ers D/ST. That's panic depth, not a plan. Nineteen point seven on the bench last Sunday. NINETEEN POINT SEVEN. The Stinky Faggots finish outside the top three, and I want that damn scavenger hunt entered into evidence.
